content.intro: A metatable changes how selected operations behave. Metamethods such as `__index`, `__newindex`, `__tostring`, and arithmetic methods are powerful, but recursive lookup and hidden behavior can make debugging difficult.

content_blocks.title: Work through the example
content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. Run with the Lua 5.5 interpreter unless the example explicitly names a host API or another runtime. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

content_blocks.code:
local ok, value = pcall(function()
    assert(2 + 2 == 4, "unexpected result")
    return "all checks passed"
end)
print(ok, value)
